failure_presence.note: The Kernel pairs a stated "fair solution" with the explicit wish "to be able to accuse the wrong person" — a wrong accusation is framed as a mistake against a true answer, not an equally valid branch.

failure_triggers.note: The accusation is a single on-page decisive beat the Kernel names directly; the snowstorm isolation is setting, not a deadline mechanic.

failure_cost.note: A wrong accusation in a fair-play mystery with one true solution reads as the losing end of the run; nothing in the Kernel suggests play continues past it.

failure_scope.note: Risk crystallizes at the accusation beat rather than running through the investigation.
